versions.changelog:
Initial release of seo-local skill for comprehensive Local SEO analysis.

- Detects business type (brick-and-mortar, service area, hybrid) and industry vertical for tailored analysis.
- Analyzes Google Business Profile integration, NAP consistency, citation health, reviews, schema markup, and location page quality.
- Includes specific checks and recommendations for multi-location SEO setups.
- Provides industry-specific guidelines for restaurants, healthcare, legal, home services, real estate, and automotive businesses.
- Integrates up-to-date local SEO statistics and best practices, referencing 2026 industry research.
